title: Can I MASTER Blindfold Chess?
summary: Series format 'Can I MASTER X': the creator plays chess.com Blindfold Chess against online humans (~1500-1560) where every piece on the board (his and the opponent's) is invisible; he only sees the empty board, last-move highlights and legal-move dots. Goal: win five games. He wins five in a row (games 1-5), two of them on time/forfeit, while talking about how blindfold training taught him to think in patterns. The edit overlays a small side board showing the real position for viewers.
rules: Standard chess rules and standard starting position.
ALL pieces of both colours are invisible on the player's board; only the empty board, the last-move from/to highlight, selection highlight and legal-move dots/capture rings are shown.
Player moves by clicking squares from memory; an illegal click simply does nothing (chess.com behaviour, inferred).
Opponent (human) also plays blindfold in the chess.com variant pool (inferred: both players are in the Blindfold variant).
win_condition: Normal checkmate, resignation or flag. Series goal: win 5 games.

opponent.name: Online humans (e.g. Mynamais..., combie)
opponent.avatar_description: Generic chess.com human avatars; for the remake use a plain grey silhouette avatar with a randomly generated username and rating ~1500-1560.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream board, completely empty of pieces during play; optional toggle to show a small reference mini-board (the video's editor overlay).

setup: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1 (rendered with all pieces hidden)
events: Game counter 1-5 boxes filled purple as games are won (channel overlay).
visual_fx: Pieces never drawn on the main board; last move squares highlighted yellow; move dots shown when a square holding a (hidden) own piece is clicked.
Optional peek/mini board (editor overlay) showing the actual position.
Green sleep-mask blindfold icon for the mode card (reference sprite fXNw2uIWqgY_blindfold_icon.png).
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'fogx' blind variant hides only ENEMY pieces; in the video ALL pieces (including the player's own) are invisible.
Legacy has a bot; video is vs ~1500 humans (fine to use a ~1500 bot but name should not be a single bot persona).
